file_roles.evidence: Adds friend qHashEquals(QPersistentModelIndex, QPersistentModelIndex) returning a.d == b.d; operator== used by QHash was inconsistent with qHash, which corrupted the hash and hit the rehash assert 'it.isUnused()'.

rationale: The hash function and equality used for QPersistentModelIndex did not agree, so QSet<QPersistentModelIndex> got corrupted and the assert fired later during insert. The fix makes equality match the hash.
